name: Centennial

fields.geographic_focus: Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Historically the largest all-digital wireless carrier in Puerto Rico and the only significant fiber-based CLEC there, with a fiber-optic network serving commercial, ISP, carrier, and government customers.
fields.provisioning_landscape: Operated CDMA wireless plus a fiber CLEC network across Puerto Rico, selling switched access lines and dedicated circuits to enterprise, ISP, carrier, and government customers via traditional carrier OSS/BSS and manual circuit ordering. Private, deterministic on-demand paths to cloud on-ramps were not part of the legacy model. Note: Centennial Communications was acquired by AT&T in 2009-2010 and the Centennial brand was retired, so this record likely reflects a defunct/absorbed entity rather than an active independent carrier.

name: Cobranet
